title: kms-region-affinity-and-audit-forwarding-middleware
author: Maya Patel
release_notes: Adds KMS region affinity hints and audit-forwarding middleware. Improves compliance visibility for cross-region KMS fallbacks and enforces tenant policy checks for key locality. Backwards compatible; feature-flagged rollout.
description: Motivation: customers with strict data residency requirements need deterministic behavior and better observability when KMS operations fall back to keys in other regions. This change introduces (1) a region-affinity hinting layer that prefers in-region keys where allowed and annotates requests when cross-region key usage is required, and (2) an audit-forwarding middleware that emits structured audit events including KMS key region, policy decision, and fallback reason. Design summary: implement a pluggable KMS routing helper that consults tenant attributes + RBAC v2 attributes and config flags, update the policy evaluator to add an explicit deny path when tenant policy forbids cross-region decrypts, and add an audit forwarder that tags and forwards enriched audit events to the central audit sink. Rollout strategy: feature-flagged under security.kms_region_affinity (default enabled for canary tenants), staged canary that runs on 10% of requests in dedicated clusters, fallback to existing paths on error, telemetry for policy-denies and fallback-rate. Migration: no data migration required; operators should verify tenant KMS bindings and optionally supply per-tenant region_hint annotations. Checklist: [x] implement routing helper, [x] add audit forwarder, [x] update policy evaluator, [x] add tests and unit coverage, [x] e2e on canary, [x] docs/ops guide. Related: ENG-4123 (policy audit), SEC-198 (compliance ask).
commits_summary: 3 commits: 1) feat(kms): add region affinity router and config flag; 2) feat(audit): implement audit-forwarding middleware and structured event schema; 3) fix(tests/docs): address race in policy evaluator tests, add ops runbook.
changed_files: internal/kms/router.go (new): regionAffinityRouter that calculates preferred_key and fallback_reason; snippet `if tenant.Policy.ForbidCrossRegion && key.Region != tenant.Region {return deny}`. internal/audit/forwarder.go (new): emits AuditEvent{action, tenant_id, key_region, fallback_reason, policy_decision}. internal/policy/evaluator.go (modified): evaluateKeyAccess now considers attribute 'kms_region_affinity' and returns `Decision: DENY` on policy mismatch. pkg/config/security.yaml (modified): adds security.kms_region_affinity flag and rollout config. cmd/redwood-server/main.go (modified): wires middleware into GRPC/HTTP stacks. docs/ops/kms-region-affinity.md (new): operator steps and troubleshooting. api/openapi.yaml (modified): documents new audit event schema. Small snippets included in review for clarity.
